data.name: Aaid
data.gender_notes: Aaid is used as a unisex name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From Arabic ʿāʾid (عائد) 'returning, one who returns', the active participle of ʿāda 'to return', from the root ʿ-w-d. Aaid therefore means “Returning; one who returns; recurring”. Arabic active participle ʿāʾid 'returning'; from the root ʿ-w-d.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aaid expresses “Help, Support”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From Arabic ʿāʾid (عائد) 'returning, one who returns', the active participle of ʿāda 'to return', from the root ʿ-w-d.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaid total 15, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.

faq.q: What does Aaid mean in Arabic?
faq.a: Aaid is the Arabic active participle ʿāʾid (عائد), meaning 'returning, one who returns', from the root ʿ-w-d.

faq.q: What does the name Aaid mean?
faq.a: Aaid means “Returning; one who returns; recurring”.

faq.q: Where does the name Aaid come from?
What is the linguistic root of Aaid?
faq.a: The root of Aaid is ع-و-د (ʿ-w-d).

faq.q: How is Aaid written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Aaid is written عائد in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Aaid a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aaid is used as a male name.

faq.q: Does Aaid appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aaid is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aaid verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Returning; one who returns; recurring” is established by Arabic active participle ʿāʾid 'returning'; from the root ʿ-w-d..
